# docs/systems/tax_code_schema.md, "Draft, bill and passage". Country scope. Read by
# te_tax_bill_effects.txt, te_tax_triggers.txt, te_tax_support_values.txt and the support
# refresh (te_tax_gen_refresh_support); every variable read is guarded with has_variable,
# and none writes or iterates anything, so a GUI may read them too.

# One vanilla tax level per channel, for the support model's delta-levels.
te_tax_level_step_wage = 0.05
te_tax_level_step_div = 0.05
te_tax_level_step_land = 0.15
te_tax_level_step_head = 0.15
te_tax_level_step_cons = 0.05

# te_tax_base_<record>_<key>: the index in force under existing law in the draft's (dr) or
# the bill's (bl) due month: the enacted value, its successor if its sunset falls by then,
# then each awaiting package due earlier (one due on or after it is superseded at
# approval), with that package's own sunset preview. The draft's untouched provisions
# start from it; the bill's support model measures change against it.

				}
				value = var:te_tax_pb_div_succ
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_bl_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_div
				var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp <= var:te_tax_bl_due
					var:te_tax_pa_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pa_div_succ
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_bl_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_div
				var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp <= var:te_tax_bl_due
					var:te_tax_pa_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pa_div_succ
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_bl_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pb_div
				var:te_tax_pb_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pb_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pb_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pb_div_exp <= var:te_tax_bl_due
					var:te_tax_pb_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pb_div_succ
			}
		}
	}
}

# The bill's change per instrument: in index steps (0 if untouched), then in vanilla tax levels.
te_tax_bl_dstep_wage = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_wage var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_bl_wage
		subtract = te_tax_base_bl_wage
	}
}
te_tax_dl_wage = {
	value = te_tax_bl_dstep_wage
	multiply = te_tax_step_wage
	divide = te_tax_level_step_wage
}
te_tax_bl_dstep_div = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_div var:te_tax_bl_div >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_bl_div
		subtract = te_tax_base_bl_div
	}
}
te_tax_dl_div = {
	value = te_tax_bl_dstep_div
	multiply = te_tax_step_div
	divide = te_tax_level_step_div
}
te_tax_bl_dstep_land = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_land var:te_tax_bl_land >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_bl_land
		subtract = te_tax_base_bl_land
	}
}
te_tax_dl_land = {
	value = te_tax_bl_dstep_land
	multiply = te_tax_step_land
	divide = te_tax_level_step_land
}
te_tax_bl_dstep_head = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_head var:te_tax_bl_head >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_bl_head
		subtract = te_tax_base_bl_head
	}
}
te_tax_dl_head = {
	value = te_tax_bl_dstep_head
	multiply = te_tax_step_head
	divide = te_tax_level_step_head
}
te_tax_bl_dstep_cons = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_cons var:te_tax_bl_cons >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_bl_cons
		subtract = te_tax_base_bl_cons
	}
}
te_tax_dl_cons = {
	value = te_tax_bl_dstep_cons
	multiply = te_tax_step_cons
	divide = te_tax_level_step_cons
}

# Revenue direction: the sum of the changes. Progressivity: income channels minus the rest.
te_tax_dl_total = {
	value = te_tax_dl_wage
	add = te_tax_dl_div
	add = te_tax_dl_land
	add = te_tax_dl_head
	add = te_tax_dl_cons
}
te_tax_dl_prog = {
	value = te_tax_dl_wage
	add = te_tax_dl_div
	subtract = te_tax_dl_land
	subtract = te_tax_dl_head
	subtract = te_tax_dl_cons
}

# How many provisions the bill changes.
te_tax_bl_provisions = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_wage var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_div var:te_tax_bl_div >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_land var:te_tax_bl_land >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_head var:te_tax_bl_head >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_cons var:te_tax_bl_cons >= 0 } add = 1 }
}

# Support reasons per interest group, each clamped to -40..40. Material:
# -10 x the exposure-weighted change in tax levels. Ideology: 5 x the
# group's fiscal ideology (its stances on the vanilla taxation laws x their progressiveness
# / 100) x the change in progressivity. Government: +10 in government.
te_tax_mat_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_wage multiply = 0.3 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_div multiply = 0.2 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_land multiply = 0.1 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_head multiply = 0.3 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_cons multiply = 0.4 }
	multiply = -10
	min = -40
	max = 40
}
te_tax_ideo_p_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	# law_consumption_based_taxation, progressiveness -100
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > approve } } } add = -2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > neutral } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 1 }
	# law_land_based_taxation, progressiveness -50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > approve } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	# law_proportional_taxation, progressiveness 50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > approve } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -1 }

	# law_proportional_taxation, progressiveness 50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > approve } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	# law_graduated_taxation, progressiveness 100
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > approve } } } add = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -1 }
}
te_tax_ideo_trade_unions = {
	value = te_tax_ideo_p_trade_unions
	multiply = te_tax_dl_prog
	multiply = 5
	min = -40
	max = 40
}
te_tax_gov_trade_unions = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { is_in_government = yes } } value = 10 }
}

# Clout of the non-marginal interest groups, and of those among them committed to the
# bill's current revision (te_tax_committed_share, te_tax_support_values.txt). A marginal
# group (vanilla's ig_counts_as_marginal) counts in neither; a group the country lacks
# contributes nothing.
te_tax_eligible_clout = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia
			ig:ig_intelligentsia = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_intelligentsia.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_landowners.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_rural_folk
			ig:ig_rural_folk = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_rural_folk.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_trade_unions
			ig:ig_trade_unions = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_trade_unions.ig_clout
	}
}
te_tax_committed_clout = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces
			var:te_tax_com_armed_forces = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_devout
			var:te_tax_com_devout = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_devout_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_devout_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists
			var:te_tax_com_industrialists = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_industrialists_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia
			ig:ig_intelligentsia = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia
			var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_intelligentsia.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners
			var:te_tax_com_landowners = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_landowners_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_landowners.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie
			var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_rural_folk
			ig:ig_rural_folk = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk
			var:te_tax_com_rural_folk = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_rural_folk.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_trade_unions
			ig:ig_trade_unions = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions
			var:te_tax_com_trade_unions = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_trade_unions.ig_clout
	}
}
